companies.name: Cursor
companies.description: Built to make you extraordinarily productive, agents turn ideas into code. Accelerate development by handing off tasks to Cursor.
companies.funding_notes: Anysphere. ~$3.38B total equity ($11M through seed per TechCrunch, + A/B/C/D). Series D $29.3B post-money (Nov 2025). A reported ~$2B round at ~$50B (a16z/Thrive, Apr 2026) was superseded and not confirmed closed. Acquired by SpaceX in a ~$60B all-stock deal, closed 2026-08-14.

companies.name: Cognition
companies.description: Cognition operates Devin, the first autonomous software engineer. Devin plans, writes, tests, and ships production code inside your existing workflows.
companies.funding_notes: At least ~$3.6B disclosed (sum excludes the undisclosed Mar 2025 8VC-led round, reported as 'hundreds of millions' at ~$4B). Valuations: $2B (Apr 2024), ~$4B (Mar 2025), $10.2B (Sep 2025), $26B post (May 2026), $48B (Series E, Sep 2026). Several amounts are 'over' figures ($400M+, $1B+, $2B+). Acquired Windsurf (2025) and Poke/Interaction Co. (Jul 2026).

companies.name: Etched
companies.description: Co-designed chips, racks, and software to push the pareto frontier to best-in-class throughput and interactivity.
companies.funding_notes: Company says it has raised $1.9B total (Aug 2026 release). That's more than the ~$1.63B sum of the listed rounds. Valuations: ~$5B (Jan 2026), $10.3B (Series C, Jul 2026), $21B (Aug 2026, $700M led by Jane Street; round letter not stated). Seed amount/lead (~$5.36M, 2023) is from secondary summaries.

companies.name: Mach
companies.description: Mach Industries develops and manufactures asymmetric aerospace and defense systems and components, including one-way attack UAS, glide munitions and interceptors.
companies.funding_notes: Mach Industries (defense). ~$485M total (sum of disclosed rounds; TechCrunch put it at ~$185M after the Series B). Valuations: $335M post (Series A), $470M (Series B), $1.8B (Series C, Jun 2026).

companies.name: Whop
companies.description: Whop is the place for business operators. Scale up customer acquisition and distribute your products with a few clicks. Spin up an empire in an afternoon.
companies.funding_notes: ~$272M total (per Forbes, Apr 2026). The $55M Series B (late 2024) wasn't announced at the time. Tether's $200M strategic investment (Feb 2026) valued Whop at $1.6B.

companies.name: Aaru
companies.description: Humans are unreliable narrators of their own behavior. Memory fails, incentives distort answers, and social pressure warps what people say away from what they actually do. Aaru leverages measurable outcomes and actions to become more accurate than any survey or traditional research.
companies.funding_notes: $80M Series A led by Redpoint (TechCrunch first reported it in Dec 2025, from sources, at a $1B 'headline' valuation with a lower blended valuation). Earlier pre-seed/seed amounts are undisclosed (investors include A*, Abstract, Felicis, General Catalyst, Accenture Ventures, Z Fellows), so the total excludes them.

companies.name: Avoca
companies.description: Avoca builds AI agents for home-service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical) that answer every call, book jobs, follow up on estimates and run dispatch.
companies.funding_notes: Company says it raised $125M+ across its Seed, Series A, and Series B. Valued at $1B (Apr 2026). The amount for each round isn't public. Trackers (not used) list a ~$10.3M seed (Oct 2024) and a ~$37M Series A (Jun 2025).

companies.name: Poke
companies.description: The proactive AI assistant on Apple Messages, WhatsApp, Telegram, and more. Texts like a human, really knows you, and integrates with your life in dozens of ways.
companies.funding_notes: The Interaction Company of California. $25M total: a $15M seed at $100M led by General Catalyst, plus $10M more at $300M post-money (Spark Capital), round type not stated. TechCrunch reported the $10M in Apr 2026; the Jan 2026 date is per secondary reports. Cognition acquired it in Jul 2026 (terms not disclosed).

companies.name: Mintlify
companies.description: Self-updating documentation for startups, enterprises, and agents.
companies.funding_notes: $67M total (company). Series B at a $500M valuation. The total was $21.7M after the Series A, so pre-A funding (including YC) was ~$3.2M implied.

companies.name: Greptile
companies.description: AI Code Reviews that understand your entire codebase. Automate PR reviews, catch bugs faster, improve code quality with AI-driven analysis. Try Greptile free!
companies.funding_notes: ~$30M total per Georgia Tech (Jan 2026). Series A at ~$180M valuation (TechCrunch sources). Caveat: trackers (FundUp/PitchBook, not used) report a $40M Series B (Form D, first sale 2026-08-14). I couldn't confirm it in a press release or by an EDGAR name search, so it's left out.

companies.name: Swsh
companies.description: SWSH is a fan engagement platform for live events: shared albums collect fan photos and videos and turn user-generated content into audience growth and first-party data.
companies.team: Alexandra Debow, Weilyn Chong, Nathan Ahn
companies.co_investors: Game Changers Ventures (lead), Stellation Capital, SignalFire, MaC Venture Capital
companies.funding_notes: $4M seed led by Game Changers Ventures (Jun 2026), matching the given seed/$4M.

companies.name: Posh
companies.description: Posh is an event management, ticketing and discovery platform for organizers and attendees, from house parties to music festivals.
companies.funding_notes: Total was $31M after the Series A (TechCrunch), so ~$9M was raised before the A (rounds not itemized). The $37M Series B (Mar 2026) brings the total to ~$68M. The latest round is now a Series B, not the $22M Series A given in the input.

companies.name: Listen Labs
companies.description: Customer research conducted, analyzed, and summarized by AI.
companies.funding_notes: $100M total funding (company). Valued at ~$500M per Forbes (Jan 2026). The company blog says Listen Labs is 'joining Salesforce' (2026-09-29), i.e., an acquisition.

companies.name: Bland
companies.description: Build, deploy, and monitor AI voice agents that sound human. Self-hosted models, sub-second latency, and enterprise compliance.
companies.funding_notes: Company says it has raised over $100M. Listed rounds sum to $106M; the $65M total after the Series B suggests ~$9M in earlier pre-seed/angel money not itemized.

companies.name: Cal AI
companies.description: Cal AI is an AI calorie-tracking app that estimates calories and nutrients from meal photos, barcode scans or meal descriptions.
companies.funding_notes: Reported as bootstrapped with no outside VC. MyFitnessPal acquired it (announced Mar 2026, terms undisclosed) at $30M+ annual revenue. One low-quality site claims a $14M A/$50M B (a16z), but other reports contradict this and it's excluded. Co-founder Zach Yadegari's new startup Persona raised $10M (Oct 2026); that's a separate company.

companies.name: Pure Poker
companies.description: Pure is a compliance-first platform for rake-free, real-money peer-to-peer poker in the US.
companies.funding_notes: Operates as 'Pure' (peer-to-peer real-money poker; CEO Jacob Bulbulia). $8M seed announced Jul 2026, but it was raised 'across multiple rounds' led by Hidden Capital, so it may combine SAFEs/tranches rather than one priced round.

companies.name: Nucleus
companies.description: Nucleus Genomics is a reproductive and preventive genetics company offering whole-genome health testing, embryo genetic analysis and integrated fertility services.
companies.funding_notes: Nucleus Genomics. ~$32M disclosed through the Series A. Samsung Next made a strategic investment in Feb 2026; the amount wasn't disclosed and isn't counted in the total.

companies.name: General Cybernetics
companies.description: General Cybernetics is a biotech company working on developmental bioengineering and prenatal gene therapy.
companies.funding_notes: General Cybernetics Corp (DE, inc. 2024, Boston; CEO Aydin Gokce, who matches the Foresight fellow bio on developmental bioengineering). Form D filed 2026-09-09: $15.3M equity fully sold to 36 investors, first sale 2026-08-26. The filing doesn't give a round type or investor names (Crunchbase calls it a seed, but that source isn't used).

companies.name: Orbit Engineering
companies.description: Orbit builds non-invasive vestibular neurostimulators worn behind the ear to create motion sensations for gaming and VR and to explore sleep and autonomic regulation.

grants.name: Pitch competition winnings (Georgetown programs, incl. Leonsis Family Entrepreneurship Prize / Bark Tank)

companies.funding_notes: Orbit Technologies Inc. (Georgetown spinout; CEO Steven Pang). $500K pre-seed from Dune Ventures (Nov 2023), plus 'over $50,000' in pitch-competition prizes. Trackers (VCBacked/FundedIQ/PitchBook, not used) report a ~$9.8M seed (Feb 2025), but I found no press release or primary source, so it's left out.
